sources.quote: effective today Meccanica C S.p.A. is on probation (supplier rating C minus)

findings.why: Meccanica C has been on probation since 2026-08-14. No later document lifts it, and the 2026-11-05 email says the 8D is still open. It cannot receive new parts now, so BR-220 cannot be moved to it.

sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).

findings.why: The approved source list covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL and names only Alluminio B. Meccanica C has no approval for BR-220, so it has no current release for this part, plant and customer.

sources.quote: BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: Drawing Rev C is in force, and the BOM and AP-0311 show it calls for EN AW-6082-T6. The email's 6061-T6 grade with Rp0.2 of 240 MPa does not match Rev C. It most likely comes from the superseded Rev B, so the Meccanica C billet does not meet the drawing material.

sources.quote: Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The documents contain no material certificate or test result for a Meccanica C billet for BR-220. A person must supply or confirm the grade and mechanical properties against Rev C.
